results.name: proof-nuq-roundtrip-case-3-without-restart-policy
results.expected: on the proof stack (no restart policy), a new job completes after the broker restarts
results.actual: broker 12 s to ping; new job: not completed:  Error response from daemon: container 18c3f32d0e7ab874b948b79e806daecbef4d28a1412a92218ba
results.classification: upstream-client-defect: nuq.ts getJobToProcess() awaits startSender() -> amqp.connect() outside its try/catch, so ECONNREFUSED during a broker restart escapes the queue-worker.ts:329 and nuq-worker-runner.ts:120 polling loops as an unhandled rejection and the harness exits. Not RabbitMQ-4.x-specific, not a page-size signature. Under Compose, restart: unless-stopped recovers it (V10). M2 patch candidate PC-NUQ-CONNECT.
